standards_review.notes: 5 of 13 commits violate the documented format. Guide requires 'EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence' but found: 'feat(EPMCDME-14452): Initialize filtered models on ChatPage load', 'feat(EPMCDME-14452): Integrate project-scoped model filtering in ChatConfigLlmSelector', 'feat(EPMCDME-14452): Integrate project-scoped model filtering in ChatPromptLlmSelector', 'feat(EPMCDME-14452): Add getModelsForCurrentChat getter to chatsStore', 'feat(EPMCDME-14452): Add project model filtering utility with caching' (all use conventional commits format with parentheses instead of documented colon format). Additionally, 'Latest changes' has no ticket prefix.
No code-quality.md guide exists in the repository; this standard cannot be adjudicated.

No security violations detected. Code properly handles backend-provided projectId in URLs (not user-controlled), API responses are processed safely, sensitive configuration is not leaked, and error handling is appropriate.

blocking_findings.violation: git-workflow.md § Commit Message Format requires pattern 'EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence' but 5 commits use 'feat(EPMCDME-14452): ...' (conventional commits style) and 1 uses 'Latest changes' with no ticket
blocking_findings.why_blocking: Tekton CI pipeline blocks commits that do not match the documented format; these commits will fail the gate on push
blocking_findings.remedy: Squash the feature branch into a single commit with format 'EPMCDME-14452: Capitalize Sentence' before merge, or rebase to rewrite commit subjects to the documented format
